name: Dopocchari Kuikomi M Musume ~Sensei, Watashi, Nuganakute mo Sugoindesu!~
original_name: どぽっちゃり食い込みＭ娘～先生、私、脱がなくてもすごいんです！～
source:
My mother told me of an opportunity and I decided to accept a request for tutoring. When I met Eimi-chan, I felt that there might have been a girl like her in my neighborhood in the past.

She was just as shy as she had been when she was a child, but as the sessions went on, we got to know each other better, and one day, she suddenly confessed to me that she could not see me as a tutor.

If I refused to see her as anything other than a student, she would be depressed and misunderstand her strong complex. I felt sorry for her, so I decided to be honest with her about my sexuality.

I'm an S of SM, a sadistic pervert... If I go out with you, I'll hurt you both physically and mentally...”

Eimi-chan was still surprised. But she didn't immediately say, 'No, I don't want to."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_205.html#story]official website[/url]]

My mother told me of an opportunity and I decided to accept a request for tutoring. When I met Eimi-chan, I felt that there might have been a girl like her in my neighborhood in the past.

She was just as shy as she had been when she was a child, but as the sessions went on, we got to know each other better, and one day, she suddenly confessed to me that she could not see me as a tutor.

If I refused to see her as anything other than a student, she would be depressed and misunderstand her strong complex. I felt sorry for her, so I decided to be honest with her about my sexuality.

I'm an S of SM, a sadistic pervert... If I go out with you, I'll hurt you both physically and mentally...”

Eimi-chan was still surprised. But she didn't immediately say, 'No, I don't want to."
